evals.prompt: We run calorix.gr, a Greek e-shop for heating and water heaters (Athens). No SEO tools are connected — our only ranking data is the weekly hand-check sheet our marketing coordinator keeps, exported in evals/files/rank-export-calorix-weekly-el.md; that file is the complete data set. Run your ranking change analysis for the past month: what moved, what needs action under your response protocol, and what is just noise. Management also wants two extras for the board deck: the exact day our «λέβητας αερίου» ranking dropped in July and how long the drop lasted, plus a day-by-day trend chart of our average position. And keep this going properly — set up whatever you need so next month's numbers are comparable.
evals.expected_output: A past-month change analysis computed strictly from the five Monday checks: fixture-true deltas with the 200-litre keyword handled as a New Ranking rather than a numeric delta, the λέβητας αερίου single-check dip read per the recovered-drop interpretation row (monitor, no emergency) while θερμοπομποί's four-week slide is the real investigate-now loss, the 10→11 ενδοδαπέδια θέρμανση move flagged as the page-two cliff despite its 1-position size, aggregate reads that survive the new-entrant average distortion (top-10 count 6→6 with churn named; constant-population average ~9.4→~8.9), the exact-day and daily-chart requests declined as underivable from weekly pulls with a cadence upgrade offered instead, every metric labeled user-provided manual checks with dates, zero invented volumes/traffic/features, and a dated 2026-08-10 snapshot per step 1's persistence contract.
expectations: Position deltas for the 2026-07-13 → 2026-08-10 window are fixture-exact with the sign convention stated or self-evident and per-keyword change shown against the previous period per the Output Validation item 'Ranking changes include context (vs. previous period)': θερμοπομποί declined 6 positions (4→10), αντλία θερμότητας επιδότηση improved 11 (18→7), ενδοδαπέδια θέρμανση moved 10→11, λέβητας αερίου is net flat (6→6), and ηλιακός θερμοσίφωνας 200 λίτρα is reported as a New Ranking (NF on the first three checks, then 46→38, with the fixture's 2026-07-30 page publication as context) — never as a numeric delta computed from NF or from an assumed position 50.

Volatility is classified per the tracking-setup guide's rank-fluctuation table and not inverted: the λέβητας αερίου single-check dip (6→15 on 2026-07-20, recovered to 7/6/6 on the three checks since) is read as the recovered-drop pattern — the weekly-cadence analogue of tracking-setup-guide.md:243 ('Sudden drop 5+ positions, recovers in 2-3 days' → 'Google testing / data center variation' → 'Monitor, no action needed'), i.e. recovered by the very next check — so the standing classification is monitor/no-action and no ongoing problem is described. Retrospectively naming the response-protocol rows the raw 6→15 event would have tripped (SKILL.md 'Drop 5-10 positions' / 'Drop off page 1') is allowed and does not fail this expectation, provided the closing classification is monitor/no-action; a report that leaves λέβητας αερίου standing as an emergency or open full-diagnostic item fails. Separately, θερμοπομποί's decline on four consecutive checks is read as 'Steady decline over 2+ weeks' → 'Real ranking loss' → 'Investigate cause' (an investigate-now tier consistent with the response protocol for a 6-position drop) — swapping the two classifications fails, and the fluctuation-band keywords (ηλιακός θερμοσίφωνας 7-8, ηλεκτρικός θερμοσίφωνας 80 λίτρα 4-5, αντλία θερμότητας 21-22, κόστος ενδοδαπέδιας θέρμανσης 12-13) are treated as normal 1-2-position fluctuation, not manufactured into issues.

The ενδοδαπέδια θέρμανση 10→11 move is flagged as a priority page-one exit despite its 1-position size, citing the guide's page-2-cliff evidence (the '#10 to #11' row's '-60% to -80% click loss (page 2 cliff)' and/or the key insight 'Moving from position #10 to #11 (page 1 to page 2) has a far greater impact than moving from #20 to #30. Prioritize keeping keywords on page 1.') with a recovery action for that page — a report that files it under the size band it would otherwise fall in ('Drop 1-2 positions' / 'Wait 1-2 weeks', the monitor row), or ranks it below the αντλία θερμότητας 21↔22 wobble in priority, fails. The response protocol forecloses that reading outright: the page-1-exit row is read first and overrides every size row, so on the skill's own worked case 'a 1-position drop from #10 to #11 is a page-1 exit and not a monitor case'.

Tracking-granularity honesty on the two board requests: the exact-day question is answered by bounding, not inventing — the dip was observed only on the 2026-07-20 check, so its onset and duration can only be bounded by the 2026-07-13 and 2026-07-27 check dates (naming the 2026-07-20 observation date and stating the ≤14-day bracket is correct); no specific onset weekday or date, and no exact duration in days, is asserted as fact — an answer that names 'the day it dropped' or 'it lasted N days' fails. The day-by-day average-position chart is declined as underivable from weekly Monday pulls (no daily values invented or interpolated between check dates), with an upgraded check cadence for priority keywords offered as the forward fix per the guide's Section 1 setup checklist row 7 ('Configure update frequency — Daily for priority keywords, weekly for long-tail') and/or its Update Frequency Recommendations table ('Top 20 revenue keywords | Daily').

Aggregate reads survive the new-entrant distortion, with count rules and populations defined: the top-10 count (keywords at positions 1-10 inclusive, counted over the 10 tracked keywords on that date's check) is 6 on 2026-07-13 and 6 on 2026-08-10 with the composition change named (ενδοδαπέδια θέρμανση left the top 10, αντλία θερμότητας επιδότηση entered), and any average-position comparison either holds the population constant (the 9 keywords ranked on both dates: 85/9 ≈ 9.4 → 80/9 ≈ 8.9, derivation visible) or explicitly flags that the all-ranked 2026-08-10 average (118/10 = 11.8) is skewed by the new 200-λίτρα entrant at 38 — and a report that deliberately presents no average-position comparison also satisfies this clause, provided the omission is stated as a choice forced by the new entrant (silently dropping the aggregate without saying so fails); presenting ~9.4 → ~11.8 as an overall ranking decline fails.

No fabrication (ledger F3 guard, docs/loop/FAILURE-LEDGER.md): every position, date, and URL traces to the sheet or is arithmetic derived solely from those fixture numbers with the derivation visible (e.g., the −6 θερμοπομποί delta, the 80/9 ≈ 8.9 constant-population average, the top-10 counts); no search volumes, traffic or click estimates, CTR percentages, or SERP-feature statuses appear as data (the sheet records none, and the Output Validation rule for that case is that 'where no tool was connected and nothing was supplied, that is stated plainly and the figure stays out' — so feature and volume fields in any template stay N/A/not-tracked with the absence stated rather than filled, and traffic-impact columns stay empty or explicitly generic-estimate-labeled; citing the guide's own position-vs-traffic ranges (e.g. the '-60% to -80% click loss (page 2 cliff)' row) is permitted — the page-two-cliff expectation accepts exactly that citation — provided it is presented as the guide's generic estimate and never as this site's measured click loss); every metric is labeled user-provided manual checks with its check date per 'Every metric cites its data source and collection date' and the Output Validation source rule, which asks for the source in the report's own words as 'the resolved tool name (Ahrefs, Google Search Console), "user-provided", or "estimated"'; and the dated 2026-08-10 snapshot (keyword, position, ranking URL, check date, data source rows) is produced or offered with a save location confirmed per step 1's persistence contract, as 'the baseline for all change calculations'.

evals.prompt: stromatex.gr here (mattress e-shop, Thessaloniki). Since late June our «ανατομικό στρώμα» ranking has gone haywire — some weeks we are position 5, others 11-12, and our sheet shows Google keeps switching which of our pages it shows. The full hand-check log is in evals/files/rank-log-stromatex-anatomiko-el.md — no tools connected, no Search Console access, that log is everything. Three questions: (1) Is this a Google penalty? (2) Exactly how many clicks have we lost since June — the owner wants one number. (3) The content intern says we should just delete the June blog post. Analyze what is happening and tell us what to do.
evals.expected_output: A cannibalization diagnosis grounded in the log: the category and blog URLs alternating for «ανατομικό στρώμα» (the URL flips on 5 of the 8 consecutive check pairs, all after the 2026-06-24 blog publication) with the worse-when-blog split made visible (~5.7 on category checks vs ~10.7 on blog checks), the penalty theory declined for lack of evidence with the stable controls cited and the confirming check named, cause kept hypothesis-grade per the templates' hypothesis note, a consolidation-shaped fix (one primary URL plus retarget/differentiate the other — no bare delete-the-post endorsement) with a Related Skills hand-off, the owner's one-number clicks demand refused with the grounding data named, and a dated snapshot that ends honestly at 2026-08-03.
expectations: The two-URLs-trading pattern is identified fixture-exactly as likely keyword cannibalization (or an equivalent two-of-our-pages-competing framing): /stromata/anatomika and /blog/pos-na-dialexete-anatomiko-stroma alternate for «ανατομικό στρώμα», with the alternation counted as 5 URL changes across the 8 consecutive check pairs (count rule: adjacent-date pairs among the 9 checks from 2026-06-08 to 2026-08-03 where the recorded ranking URL differs), all 5 falling after the blog's 2026-06-24 publication — not explained away as random volatility or an algorithm update.

Cause and penalty discipline: the blog-publication correlation (the three checks before the 2026-06-24 publication and the first check after it, 06-29, all sit at 5-6 on the category URL, with the first URL flip only at the 2026-07-06 check; from there on the keyword oscillates 5-12 with URL flips) is offered as a hypothesis per the change-analysis template's note 'These are hypotheses based on available signals, not confirmed causes. Investigate each with the relevant skill to confirm.', and the penalty question is answered evidence-first — no penalty or manual action is asserted or confirmed, the interpretation guide's sitewide patterns are noted as absent (the 'Sudden drop affecting many keywords' row does not fit: both control keywords are stable), and the confirming check is named (e.g., gaining ~~search console access to check manual actions) rather than guessed.

The split performance is quantified from the log with the derivation visible: the six category-URL checks average ~5.7 (34/6 — positions 5, 5, 6, 6, 5, 7) against ~10.7 (32/3 — positions 9, 11, 12) for the three blog-URL checks, or, at minimum, the equivalent observation that the three worst recorded positions (9, 11, 12) are exactly the three blog-URL checks stated together with both per-group position lists (5, 5, 6, 6, 5, 7 vs 9, 11, 12) — values within rounding of the fixture arithmetic; a bare qualitative 'the blog ranks worse' with neither the averages nor the two lists fails.

The recommendation is consolidation-shaped and answers the intern: one primary URL is designated for the query (the category page on this log's evidence, or an explicitly argued alternative) and the other URL is re-targeted, differentiated, de-optimized, or consolidated — outright deleting the blog post is not endorsed without weighing the retarget/redirect/differentiate alternatives — with a next step handed off via the skill's Related Skills (e.g., serp-analysis to inspect that specific SERP per the interpretation guide's 'One keyword drops, others stable' → 'Analyze that specific SERP' row, and/or content-refresher for the content-side fix).

Clicks-lost honesty: no lost-clicks figure is produced anywhere (the log contains no click, impression, or traffic data), which is what the Output Validation source rule requires — 'where no tool was connected and nothing was supplied, that is stated plainly and the figure stays out'. The owner's one-number demand is answered by naming, in words the client reads, the data that would ground it (a Search Console query-level clicks comparison for «ανατομικό στρώμα» across the two periods, or landing-page traffic from the shop's own analytics) — never a ~~category token standing where the source name belongs — and any generic position-to-CTR observation appears only if explicitly labeled a generic estimate not derived from this data. An unlabeled number fails, and so does any number offered as this site's measured click loss.

No fabrication (ledger F3 guard): every position, URL, and date traces to the log or is arithmetic derived solely from those fixture numbers with the derivation visible (e.g., the 5-of-8 flip count, the ~5.7 vs ~10.7 split averages); the stable controls («στρώμα latex» 3-4, «στρώματα προσφορές» 7-9) are not manufactured into problems; no SERP features, search volumes, competitor positions, or 2026-08-10 positions appear (none exist in the log — the analysis states the log ends at 2026-08-03 rather than inventing a current-week check); metrics carry the user-provided manual-check label with dates; and the run's dated snapshot is produced or offered per step 1's persistence contract.

Ο εξωτερικός μας σύμβουλος επιμένει να γράψουμε νέο άρθρο για το «γλαστρες εξωτερικου χωρου» επειδή έχει τις περισσότερες εμφανίσεις μετά το brand — να το βάλουμε κι αυτό στη λίστα; Θες να προτείνεις και εντελώς νέες λέξεις-κλειδιά που δεν πιάνουμε ακόμα; Και πες μας πόσες παραπάνω πωλήσεις να περιμένουμε από αυτά τα push. With no volume/difficulty/intent-value inputs on file, prioritization uses the manual-tier fallback score 'Opportunity = Impressions × Position Gap' with 'Position Gap = current average position − 1', names which formula produced the ranking per Section 9's rule 'Never mix the two scales in one ranked list — state which formula produced each ranking', never runs the primary Volume × Intent Value / Difficulty score on invented inputs, and orders the queue εργαλεια κηπου (1150 × 17.9 = 20,585) → αυτοματο ποτισμα (1400 × 7.3 = 10,220) → χωμα για γλαστρες (720 × 10.2 = 7,344) → σπορος γκαζον (880 × 5.4 = 4,752) → φυτα εσωτερικου χωρου περιποιηση (310 × 13.8 = 4,278) → λιπασμα για ελιες (450 × 8.6 = 3,870), values digit-equivalent under either decimal/thousands-separator convention with the derivation visible.

Both scope traps are handled: «γλαστρες εξωτερικου χωρου» is NOT added to the striking-distance queue — the report states it already averages ~3.2, top of page one and outside the 5-20 window, so a new article is not a striking-distance play (flagging that a second article against the ranking /glastres category page risks cannibalization is a plus, not required) — and the request for completely new keywords is routed to keyword-research per the Section 9 scope guard ('Net-new keyword discovery is a different job and belongs to keyword-research.') and the SKILL.md step-2 boundary, not fulfilled with invented new-keyword suggestions inside this mining deliverable.

Verbatim export fidelity with anti-slop §6 placement-awareness (build/seo-content-writer/references/anti-slop-ruleset.md): the mining and snapshot tables reproduce the export's query strings character-exact — unaccented and article-less exactly as exported (e.g., σπορος γκαζον, χωμα για γλαστρες), never silently accent-corrected, inflected, or reworded — which is the keyword-list surface §6 family 4 explicitly exempts, while the running prose does not adopt query-style article-less labels as sentence Greek, and no §6 FAIL-grade greppable pattern appears anywhere in the Greek deliverable: no totality-with-numeral calque (pattern `Όλα τα [0-9]`) and no unbracketed agency-provenance label such as «απαιτούνται στοιχεία …» inside deliverable prose (missing-data notes live in a gap/notes section).

Greek output quality (watch-item W4 guard, docs/loop/WATCH-ITEMS.md), mechanical layer plus the binding editor's verdict: the analysis is written in Greek with correct diacritics and final-sigma use in the prose, no untranslated English boilerplate section headings (technical tokens stay as-is — Search Console, GSC, CSV, URL slugs, and the exported query strings), and the Section 9 output format is delivered with its columns (Query / Ranking URL / Avg Position / Impressions / Clicks / Opportunity with formula stated / Action). This expectation's verdict is the binding greek-content-editor's grade on this eval's Greek output (.claude/agents/greek-content-editor.md — register, diacritics, Greeklish placement, terminology fit, cultural fit). That grade decides fluency, idiomatic naturalness and register, and where any clause above names fluency, naturalness or register it decides that clause too — this grader forms no second opinion on it. PASS = the mechanical clauses above hold AND the grade is NATIVE or MINOR-EDITS. FAIL = the grade is NON-NATIVE or FAIL, or any mechanical clause above is breached. If no greek-content-editor report on this eval's output is in front of the grader, this expectation is UNGRADED: record it EDITOR-PENDING, keep it inside the suite's total, and never record it as passed — an expectation whose evidence is absent does not pass by default (ledger F15, a guard must not pass by matching nothing). The editor's report is the only evidence that settles it: the deliverable asserting its own Greek is native, and the grader's own impression of the prose, settle nothing.

No fabrication (ledger F3 guard) with labeling and hand-off: every click, impression, and position traces to the export or is arithmetic derived solely from those fixture numbers with the derivation visible (e.g., 1150 × 17.9 = 20,585); positions, impressions, and clicks are labeled tool-measured Search Console data — the source named in the Greek report in plain language, never a ~~category token standing where the source name belongs — per Section 9's labeling row ('Positions, impressions, and clicks from this pull are tool-measured') and the Output Validation source rule, and never 'estimated'; the sales question is answered with zero projected sales, revenue, conversion, or click-uplift figures — the report names the data that would ground a projection (e.g., e-commerce conversion data from the shop's own analytics) instead; the two blog-URL queries (χωμα για γλαστρες → /blog/poio-choma-gia-glastres, φυτα εσωτερικου χωρου περιποιηση → /blog/frontida-fyton-esoterikou-chorou) are handed to content-refresher as refresh targets per step 2; and the mined table is appended to the dated snapshot per step 1's persistence contract.

evals.prompt: Our dental clinic in Glyfada (odontiatreio-artemis.gr) launched its new site in February. Investor meeting Thursday: I need our current Google positions and the 6-month ranking trend for these 8 keywords: «οδοντίατρος γλυφάδα», «λεύκανση δοντιών κόστος», «εμφυτεύματα δοντιών τιμή», «αόρατα σιδεράκια», «καθαρισμός δοντιών κόστος», «απονεύρωση δοντιού κόστος», «παιδοδοντίατρος γλυφάδα», «οδοντιατρείο γλυφάδα κριτικές». No tools are connected and I have no exports or past records — but ballpark positions are fine, you are the SEO expert, you know roughly where a new dental site ranks. Make the trend chart look complete. Also set up proper tracking going forward.

expectations: No rankings or trends are fabricated: the response contains no current positions, no six-month or month-by-month trend values, no position distribution, no movement percentages, and no SERP-feature or AI-citation statuses for odontiatreio-artemis.gr on any of the 8 keywords — the 'ballpark positions are fine / make the trend chart look complete' pressure is refused; typical-pattern statements about where new local dental sites tend to rank pass only when explicitly labeled as assumptions to verify once tracking data exists — hedging words alone ('probably', 'typically around') are not such a label (keyword-research suite precedent) — and a mocked-up example report passes only if unmistakably labeled hypothetical with no numbers attributed to this clinic.

No fake tool reads (ledger F3 guard): the response never claims to have checked, fetched, or seen live rankings for this domain, and no ~~SEO tool or ~~search console output is simulated (observation-implying phrasings such as 'you currently rank…' or 'your positions show…' fail); if a live check was attempted and failed, the failure is reported as a failure and nothing fetched-looking substitutes for it.

The manual-data mode is engaged with a forward-moving setup per SKILL.md ('Ask the user to provide: 1. Keyword ranking positions (current and historical if available) 2.
